entities.summary: Nathan Alterman was an Israeli poet, playwright, journalist, and translator. He was associated with Zionist political movements and played a significant role in shaping public discourse, although he never held elected office. Nathan Alterman was a journalists & chroniclers from Warsaw (1910-08-14, Warsaw–1970-03-28). A moderately significant entity in the historical record. Relevant to cause-and-effect analysis.
